scope: Offline adapter implementation and20 synthetic tests; not actual bundle construction, experiment execution, semantic scoring or main authorization
reviewer: Codex AI assistance /root/method_audit; root separately read the completed adapter and reported no blocking finding. This is engineering/method review, not independent-human or statistical-rater validation.

errors.reason: Twenty synthetic tests pass. Missing/live/unbound terminal metadata, hidden request count, changed prepared input, substituted own D0, unassigned source, extra generation, overlapping/existing output paths and during-packaging mutation are rejected. Raw budget errors are retained and partial/missing finals remain explicit diagnostics or unavailable items.

consistency.reason: The adapter requires terminal receipt+summary before model-text traversal, explicit continuation/main runtime gate validation, real campaign accounting, exact frozen initial messages and actual own D0. It uses old rubric/text/final-visible-evidence helpers without global mutation. All planned4/5 items and8/10 slots remain in private accounting; judge denominators remain44/55 sector rows.

paper_topic.reason: Each judge item contains exact raw final/prior text and only evidence actually present in its attempted final. Institution meaning, stated reasons, numeric claims and raw choices remain reviewable one output at a time. Derived allocations, endpoint amendment, condition mapping, run paths and execution-order metadata remain private; arithmetic100% cannot supply grounds for raw prose truth.

coverage: Entire terminal campaign prerequisite is exercised before accounting or text extraction, including an already-present but live summary.
Continuation4 and main5 inventories remain distinct; main cannot acquire historical pilot rows. Missing finals stay in planned denominators and are not replaced by prior responses.
Raw sum1.2 examples remain exact in judge text while deterministic derived diagnostics exist only in private mapping.

Recorded partial event prefix remains exact and explicitly not normally completed; a final preflight with zero generation attempts contributes no final-visible evidence even if a request payload was prepared.

Only actual final evidence is selected. Initial institution exposure metadata and source-order/condition labels are omitted from review structure; prior response itself is retained verbatim and can reveal a condition.
Raw/source/input hashes, own-history correspondence, citation-visible evidence boundaries and original r2 semantic rubric reuse are checked.

Synthetic runtime settings use mocks only at the new adapter boundary; real runtime validation is lazy and explicitly dispatched to sector_continuation_runtime or sector_main_runtime for actual later use.

judge_contents: Original r2 review dimensions with source-free applicability wording and no composite score
Exact final.txt and prior.txt when observed
Recorded final-visible common context/market/schema, assigned institution packet or null, common system instruction, final instruction and actual draft feedback
Explicit normal/partial/unbound/missing availability and full planned final/row denominators
private_contents: Case/condition mapping and original case order
Run, terminal, gate/protocol, stage and source paths/hashes
Full campaign accounting and deterministic math diagnostics
privacy_contract.no_injected_metadata: No prior exposure metadata, case ID, run path, hypothesis or derived-math ground is injected into judge item/index/rubric. Verbatim model/source text is not redacted if it reveals identity or condition.
privacy_contract.masking_limit: Masking is incomplete; evidence presence, source identity or raw prior/final text can reveal the condition. No independent-human, balanced independent sample, validated agreement or winning-answer claim.

constraints: Do not invoke before full campaign terminal. A stopped terminal campaign may be packaged with honest missing/partial diagnostics.
Judge tree must be disjoint from raw, private mapping and declared campaign report trees. Existing output paths are never overwritten.
COMPLETE.json is written last; validation/writing failure does not produce a complete bundle. Preserve any failed packaging attempt.
Dispatch a fresh reviewer using only one opaque item plus rubric/evidence; keep mapping and prior audits outside that reviewer context.
Actual semantic review remains pending until the reviewer reads the item.

limitations: Synthetic tests do not certify a future actual campaign terminal, actual output semantics or gate approval.
Artifact checks detect inconsistency/mutation, not deliberate fabrication of every record by an operator.
The accepted campaign finalizer computes arithmetic in memory to validate lineage/accounting; those derived results are deliberately private and are not semantic evidence.
No frozen old builder/runtime/main source or candidate gate was changed.
